description: This file defines the AccountController class with methods for handling account-related HTTP requests such as registration, login, invitation, verification, password reset, Stripe session creation, logout, and basic auth checks. It imports express types, status codes, utility functions, and account service dependencies.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: Controller class managing account-related HTTP endpoints such as registration, login, invitation, verification, password management, Stripe session creation, logout, and basic authentication.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration by invoking AccountService.register with request body.

methods.name: invite
methods.description: Handles account invitation by invoking AccountService.invite with request body and user.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login via AccountService.login with request body.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies account via AccountService.verify with request body.

methods.name: resendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Resends verification email via AccountService.resendVerificationEmail with request body.

methods.name: forgotPassword
methods.description: Initiates password reset process via AccountService.forgotPassword with request body.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets password via AccountService.resetPassword with request body.

methods.name: createStripeCustomerPortalSession
methods.description: Creates Stripe customer portal session via getRunningExpressApp().identityManager.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out user, clears session or cookies, and redirects as appropriate.

methods.name: getBasicAuth
methods.description: Checks if username and password are set in environment variables.

methods.name: checkBasicAuth
methods.description: Validates provided username and password against environment variables.
